definition: Entirely invented rates and design, not experimental evidence.
technical_well_generation: For each condition-specific sample mean m, duplicate wells are [0.99*m, 1.01*m]. Their mean is m. Each formulation has its own measured day-0 pair, with the means deliberately equal across formulations within a lot in this invented case.
formula: 100 * mean(day14 technical wells) / mean(matched day0 technical wells)
rate_unit: U/mL; assumed 1 U = 1 micromol substrate converted per minute under the assay conditions
source_SYN_L2: Original invented follow-up design, not completed work or a power analysis.
